_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json; ADR-031 declarative-first; ADR-022 consume OR audit-trail / RBAC; ADR-024 register-not-table.
_meta.description: T2 schatkistbankieren (treasury banking compliance) — declarative TreasuryAccount + BankingRule + ComplianceReport registers with x-openregister-lifecycle (TreasuryAccount draft→configured→active→monitored→compliant with suspended/archived), x-openregister-calculations (ComplianceReport.complianceScore + criteriaResults weighted-rule-match), x-openregister-aggregations (by administration+period, by ruleType, aging buckets), and x-openregister-audit-trail per ADR-022. Seeds three baseline BankingRule records (rule-iban-format, rule-segregation, rule-approval-required) loaded idempotently by ConfigurationService::importFromApp. Multi-criteria compliance precondition on TreasuryAccount.activate is declared in x-openregister-lifecycle.transitions.activate.preconditions; if OR's engine cannot evaluate multi-criteria preconditions declaratively, the ADR-031 exception path is OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\ComplianceValidator::isCompliant (single-method, registered out-of-band — not authored by this spec by default). No PHP ComplianceService, ComplianceReportService, ComplianceScoringService, ComplianceAggregationService is shipped — per REQ-SCHATKIST-006 / REQ-SCHATKIST-007 scoring and aggregation are calculation/aggregation extensions.

TreasuryAccount.title: Treasury Account
TreasuryAccount.description: Treasury-managed bank account governed under Dutch schatkistbankieren regulations (REQ-SCHATKIST-002). Carries IBAN, compliance classification, master-list status, optional GL linkage and lifecycle state (draft → configured → active → monitored → compliant; plus suspended / archived). Activation enforces multi-criteria compliance preconditions against the active BankingRule register per REQ-SCHATKIST-005. Lifecycle transitions materialise audit-trail events per ADR-022 + T2 bookkeeping-audit-trail (REQ-SCHATKIST-008).

iban.description: Full Dutch IBAN (REQ-SCHATKIST-002). Validated against the Dutch IBAN pattern by BankingRule.rule-iban-format on activation per REQ-SCHATKIST-005.
iban.title: IBAN

description.example: Primary treasury sweep account for 2026 audit year.
description.title: Description

linkedAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber for GL classification (T1 chart-of-accounts).
linkedAccountNumber.title: Linked Account Number

lastCompliantDate.description: Last datetime a compliance check confirmed all active rules pass. Used by the aging aggregation (REQ-SCHATKIST-007).
lastCompliantDate.title: Last Compliant Date

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Treasury account created but not yet configured (REQ-SCHATKIST-004).

configured.label: Configured
configured.description: Account configured with IBAN, classification, administration; awaiting compliance check.

active.label: Active
active.description: Activation passed multi-criteria compliance check per REQ-SCHATKIST-005.

monitored.label: Monitored
monitored.description: Periodic compliance monitoring is running for this account.

compliant.label: Compliant
compliant.description: Compliance officer has signed off on monitoring results.

suspended.label: Suspended
suspended.description: Compliance failure or policy change has suspended the account.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Operator archived the account; no further activity.

configure.label: Configure
configure.description: Operator configures IBAN, classification, administration scoping (REQ-SCHATKIST-004).

activate.label: Activate
activate.description: Multi-criteria compliance check evaluates all active BankingRule criteria scoped to the account's administration (REQ-SCHATKIST-005). All rules must pass; any failure blocks the transition and is recorded as a compliance audit event per REQ-SCHATKIST-008.

preconditions.description: Multi-criteria compliance precondition (REQ-SCHATKIST-005): every BankingRule where isActive=true AND administrationId=@self.administrationId MUST evaluate to PASS for this account. Engine MUST evaluate every applicable rule (no short-circuit) and persist per-rule results onto the resulting ComplianceReport.criteriaResults; if ANY rule fails the transition is blocked.

rules.check: no other TreasuryAccount in administrationId has the same iban when BankingRule.evaluationCriteria.checkDuplicates=true

preconditions.fallback: If the engine cannot evaluate multi-criteria preconditions declaratively, ADR-031 exception path applies: OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\ComplianceValidator::isCompliant($accountId, $rules) is called by the lifecycle engine.

sideEffects.description: On successful activation a ComplianceReport with status=draft is generated capturing per-rule pass/fail and the weighted complianceScore.

monitor.label: Begin Monitoring
monitor.description: Scheduled monitoring job or operator trigger; all active BankingRule criteria must continue to pass (REQ-SCHATKIST-004).

preconditions.description: All active BankingRule records for this administration MUST still pass on transition to monitored.

signOffCompliant.label: Sign Off Compliant
signOffCompliant.description: Compliance officer signs off on monitoring results (REQ-SCHATKIST-004). Audit trail records actor + transition per REQ-SCHATKIST-008.

suspend.label: Suspend
suspend.description: Compliance failure or policy change. The blocking reason MUST be recorded on the audit-trail event per REQ-SCHATKIST-008.

suspendFromMonitored.label: Suspend (from monitored)
suspendFromMonitored.description: Suspension can also occur during the monitored phase when a periodic compliance check fails.

reactivate.label: Re-activate
reactivate.description: Operator remediated the failure; all active BankingRule criteria must pass again (REQ-SCHATKIST-004).

preconditions.description: Re-activation MUST re-evaluate every active BankingRule for this administration; all rules must pass before the account returns to active.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR's audit-trail-immutable captures every create / update / lifecycle / delete event on TreasuryAccount with actor (IUserSession), timestamp, action, before/after snapshot, and hash chain per ADR-022 + REQ-SCHATKIST-008. Compliance-rule-evaluation results are recorded on the transition to active/monitored; blocking reasons are recorded on suspend transitions. Retention is governed by OR per the T2 bookkeeping-audit-trail spec.

BankingRule.title: Banking Rule
BankingRule.description: Configurable compliance criterion enforced during treasury-account lifecycle transitions (REQ-SCHATKIST-003). Operators configure rules per administration; the evaluation criteria payload varies by ruleType (iban-format → pattern, segregation → checkDuplicates, approval-required → requiresTreasurerApproval, transaction-limit → maxAmount, reporting-period → cadence). Severity drives whether a rule blocks the transition or is recorded as a warning/informational note on the resulting ComplianceReport.

description.example: Validates that the treasury account IBAN follows the Dutch IBAN structure (NL country code + 2 check digits + 4-letter bank code + 10-digit account number).
description.title: Description

evaluationCriteria.description: Criteria payload — shape varies by ruleType (REQ-SCHATKIST-003). iban-format: { pattern: string }. segregation: { checkDuplicates: boolean }. approval-required: { requiresTreasurerApproval: boolean }. transaction-limit: { maxAmount: number, currency: string }. reporting-period: { cadence: enum }.
evaluationCriteria.title: Evaluation Criteria

severity.description: Rule severity (REQ-SCHATKIST-003). blocking = activation/monitoring fails; warning = transition allowed but flagged; informational = recorded only.
severity.title: Severity

isActive.description: Whether this rule is enforced in the administration (REQ-SCHATKIST-003).
isActive.title: Is Active

administrationId.description: FK to administration enabling per-org rule customization (REQ-SCHATKIST-003).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Audit-trail-immutable on BankingRule changes per ADR-022; operator edits to compliance criteria leave an immutable record so compliance-officer review can trace which rule revision was in force when a treasury account was activated.

ComplianceReport.title: Compliance Report
ComplianceReport.description: Periodic compliance snapshot for schatkistbankieren reporting (REQ-SCHATKIST-006). complianceScore + criteriaResults are declarative calculations (x-openregister-calculations) — weighted rule-match aggregation against the BankingRule register. status follows draft → reviewed → approved-for-export → exported. Optional regulatoryExportFormat + regulatoryExportUri capture the docudesk handover. NO ComplianceReportService.php / ComplianceScoringService.php / ReportGeneratorService.php is shipped — scoring is a calculation, not a service.

treasuryAccountId.description: FK to TreasuryAccount when this is a single-account report; null when the report aggregates the whole administration (REQ-SCHATKIST-006).
treasuryAccountId.title: Treasury Account ID

complianceScore.description: Automated score (0-100) from weighted BankingRule criteria match — declarative x-openregister-calculations output (REQ-SCHATKIST-006).
complianceScore.title: Compliance Score

criteriaResults.description: Per-rule evaluation result (REQ-SCHATKIST-006). Each entry: { ruleNumber, ruleType, severity, status: pass|fail, evaluatedAt }. Declarative x-openregister-calculations output.
criteriaResults.title: Criteria Results

regulatoryExportUri.description: Storage URI of the exported compliance report (docudesk FK contract; REQ-SCHATKIST-006).
regulatoryExportUri.title: Regulatory Export URI

complianceScore.description: Weighted rule-match aggregation per REQ-SCHATKIST-006 — sums the per-rule weight contribution of every PASSING BankingRule (where isActive=true AND administrationId=@self.administrationId), scaled to 0-100. With N active rules each rule contributes 100/N points on pass and 0 on fail (uniform weighting baseline). Operator-configurable per-rule weight overrides are out of scope for the T2 baseline.

criteriaResults.description: Per-rule evaluation status array per REQ-SCHATKIST-006 — one entry per active BankingRule with { ruleNumber, ruleType, severity, status: pass|fail, evaluatedAt }. Evaluator: each ruleType maps to the rule's evaluationCriteria payload applied to the associated TreasuryAccount(s) for the period.

complianceByAdministrationAndPeriod.description: Period-based compliance metric (REQ-SCHATKIST-007). GROUP BY (administrationId, reportPeriod) over ComplianceReport, computing totalAccounts (count distinct treasuryAccountId), compliantCount (count where complianceScore >= 100), nonCompliantCount, averageComplianceScore, and compliancePercentage = 100 * compliantCount / totalAccounts.

complianceByRuleType.description: Per-rule-type pass/fail metric (REQ-SCHATKIST-007). GROUP BY criteriaResults[].ruleType across ComplianceReport.criteriaResults flattened, counting pass vs fail to identify systematically failing rules that need operator attention.

agingByLastCompliantDate.description: Aging-by-compliance metric (REQ-SCHATKIST-007). GROUP BY TreasuryAccount.lastCompliantDate bucketed into 0-30d / 31-60d / 60+d to surface accounts that need revalidation. NO PHP aggregation service — the engine handles bucketing.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Audit-trail-immutable on ComplianceReport status changes per ADR-022; supports T2 bookkeeping-audit-trail and operator-reviewable history of regulatory exports.

objects.name: Dutch IBAN Format
objects.description: Validates that the treasury account IBAN follows the Dutch IBAN structure (NL country code + 2 check digits + 4-letter bank code + 10-digit account number) per REQ-SCHATKIST-010.

objects.name: Treasury IBAN Segregation
objects.description: Enforces IBAN uniqueness per administration — prevents two treasury accounts within the same administration from sharing an IBAN per REQ-SCHATKIST-010.

objects.name: Treasurer Approval Required
objects.description: Requires treasurer/CFO approval before activation of a treasury account per REQ-SCHATKIST-010.
